metadata.system_name: Smart Energy Consumption Prediction & Optimization System

rule_mapping.cluster_0: Optimize HVAC setpoints, pre-cool facilities before afternoon heat, and insulate Zone 3 thermal loads.
rule_mapping.cluster_1: Shift heavy appliances, dishwashers, and EV charging away from peak evening hours (6 PM - 10 PM) to off-peak night hours.
rule_mapping.cluster_2: Deploy rooftop solar PV arrays and daylight harvesting during active daytime operating hours.
rule_mapping.cluster_3: Audit nighttime standby vampire loads and maintain efficient off-peak baseline power usage.

profile.usage_behavior: High total electricity consumption across all zones, heavily driven by high ambient outdoor temperatures (avg 26.78°C). Elevated cooling demand in summer months, with Zone 3 showing disproportionately high power draw (27,295.85 kW).

key_patterns: Strong positive correlation between ambient outdoor temperature and energy draw
Zone 3 consumption is 68% higher than off-peak baseline due to cooling load
Significant afternoon and evening thermal inertia

optimization_rules.title: HVAC Thermostat Setpoint Adjustment
optimization_rules.action_description: Raise thermostat cooling setpoint by 1.5°C - 2.0°C during peak afternoon heat. Utilize smart thermostats with automated schedule adjustments.

optimization_rules.title: Off-Peak Thermal Pre-Cooling
optimization_rules.action_description: Pre-cool facility zones during low-tariff morning hours (04:00 - 09:00) when outdoor temperature is lower, reducing compressor work in peak afternoon.

optimization_rules.title: Zone 3 Thermal Insulation & Solar Shading
optimization_rules.action_description: Install reflective window films, thermal insulation, and automated window blinds to decrease radiant solar heat gain in Zone 3.

cluster_0.summary_recommendation: Pre-cool zones during early morning hours and adjust summer HVAC thermostat setpoints by 2°C to mitigate weather-driven peak demand.

profile.usage_behavior: Highest overall power consumption (avg 91,450.99 kW) concentrated almost exclusively between 18:00 and 23:00 (93.10% peak hour occurrences). Zone 1 experiences maximum load (41,796.17 kW) during these evening peak tariff windows.
profile.environmental_trigger: Peak Activity Window & Evening Utility Tariff Rates

key_patterns: 99.2% of consumption records occur between 18:00 and 23:00
Highest total power draw (91.45 MW average) in the dataset
Zone 1 peak load reaches 41.8 MW (69% above off-peak baseline)
Direct coincidence with maximum Time-of-Use (TOU) billing rates

optimization_rules.title: Peak-to-Off-Peak Load Shifting
optimization_rules.action_description: Shift flexible heavy appliances (water heaters, clothes dryers, dishwashers, heavy machinery) and EV charging from 18:00 - 22:00 to 23:00 - 06:00.

optimization_rules.title: Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Peak Shaving
optimization_rules.action_description: Charge battery storage systems during off-peak night hours (01:00 - 05:00) and discharge during peak evening hours (18:00 - 21:00) to shave Zone 1 peak demand.

optimization_rules.title: Automated Demand-Response Load Shedding
optimization_rules.action_description: Implement automated IoT relay controllers to temporarily shed non-essential loads (decorative lighting, secondary water heating) during peak grid alerts.

cluster_1.summary_recommendation: Shift heavy loads, water heaters, and EV charging from peak hours (6 PM - 10 PM) to midnight, saving up to 22% in peak demand charges.

profile.usage_behavior: Moderate-to-high consumption (avg 71,609.43 kW) concentrated during daylight and business operational hours (06:00 - 17:00). Low peak evening exposure (1.30%), representing stable daytime activity.

key_patterns: Largest cluster accounting for 35.46% of total historical time steps

optimization_rules.title: On-Site Rooftop Solar PV Integration
optimization_rules.action_description: Install rooftop solar photovoltaic panels to generate clean energy that directly aligns with peak daytime energy demand.

optimization_rules.title: Daylight Harvesting & Lighting Control
optimization_rules.action_description: Use photosensors to dynamically dim electric indoor lighting when natural daylight is sufficient, paired with motion-sensor controls.

optimization_rules.title: Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) Optimization
optimization_rules.action_description: Equip pumps, fans, and conveyor motors in Zone 1 and Zone 2 with VFDs to match motor speed with real-time operational demand.

cluster_2.summary_recommendation: Capitalize on daytime solar PV generation and daylight harvesting sensors to directly offset business-hour baseline consumption.

profile.usage_behavior: Lowest overall power consumption (avg 53,538.88 kW), occurring predominantly during late night and early morning hours (00:00 - 11:00). Represents baseline, standby, and off-peak routine usage with 0% peak evening overlap.
profile.environmental_trigger: Minimum Human Activity & Cool Night Temperatures

key_patterns: Accounts for 34.69% of all dataset observations
99.4% of points fall between 00:00 and 11:00 AM
Lowest mean total power draw (53.54 MW average)
0.02% peak hour coincidence - ideal off-peak baseline

optimization_rules.title: Vampire / Standby Load Audit & Reduction
optimization_rules.action_description: Install smart power strips and automated circuit cut-offs to eliminate standby phantom power draw from idle electronics, displays, and transformers overnight.

optimization_rules.title: Off-Peak Scheduled Operations Utilization
optimization_rules.action_description: Schedule heavy automated tasks (data backups, water pumping, EV fleet overnight charging, thermal storage charging) during these lowest-tariff hours.

cluster_3.summary_recommendation: Maintain current high efficiency baseline while auditing phantom standby loads and utilizing low off-peak rates for scheduled automated background tasks.

dashboard_summary.highest_priority_action: Shift Zone 1 evening peak load (6 PM - 10 PM) to midnight off-peak hours.
